Continuation 32 limited records SEQ-15 same 16 blind-entrances. Old results are not overwritten.Successful conclusion of series It is confirmed only by the totality COMPLETE.json, ACCEPTANCE.json and ARTIFACTS.jsonWhile these files are not available, the work continues.

Outcome after completion: FINAL_REPORT.md, computer-readable accounting RESULTS.jsonResource conditions and history: PROTOCOL.md, EXECUTION_NOTE.md. Different versions of the plans and wrappers are registered in separate manifestos.

attempts/ Keeps the main queue; graph_v2/ Repeat two graphs SEQ-12 Accelerating the construction of the graph. followup/ and priority_graph/ contain a separate version with a proven cutoff of non-productive branches. memory_retry/ It is completed only when a separate repetition is necessary random control stopped by the protection of shared memory. diagnostics/ and saved_lattice_retry/ They do not mix with the main results. Source timeout/error Records are retained after successful continuation.

Timeouts and lack of memory do not mean the absence of roots. The evidence of the limitations of the strategy is in OBSTRUCTION_PROOFS.md and OBSTRUCTION_ORDER_EXTENSION.md. They have a narrower meaning than excluding a hidden generator.

After acceptance, only a check is started without changing the artifacts:

Executable code/The commands are omitted in the documentary copy.

Don't let go status.py, summaries generators or coordinators after acceptance of: They're recording files and breaking a sealed image You need a new folder of the experiment with exact links to saved inputs.
